memory_update.text: AVGO should remain in the AI theme graph as a reference demand anchor, not an underfollowed Serenity target; its custom AI accelerator and AI networking disclosures are useful for validating upstream bottlenecks in foundry, advanced packaging, substrates, test, HBM backend, and network connectivity.

HUBN.SW should remain in the underfollowed lane as a hypothesis mapped to optical connectivity, data-center connectivity, and possible CPO-adjacent infrastructure, but its AI revenue exposure and customer qualifications need primary-source verification before promotion.

Need current Huber+Suhner primary-source evidence: annual report, segment revenue, backlog, management commentary, hyperscaler/switch OEM qualifications, product references to 800G/1.6T, CPO, silicon photonics, AI data centers, or optical interconnect applications.

Need Broadcom primary filing confirmation from FY2026 Q2 10-Q and earnings transcript for exact custom AI accelerator revenue language, remaining performance obligations, purchase commitments, customer concentration, and supply-chain capacity constraints.

For both tickers, Layer 2C should add market-pricing checks: current market cap, valuation, analyst coverage, revenue purity, short interest, liquidity, and whether the AI exposure is already fully recognized by the market.

summary: Candidate chunk maps one high-attention reference demand anchor, Broadcom, and one underfollowed optical-connectivity hypothesis, Huber+Suhner. Broadcom is not an underfollowed Serenity target but is useful as a demand/capex signal for custom AI accelerators, AI networking, TSMC capacity, advanced packaging, test, and optical/networking attach rates. Huber+Suhner remains a weaker-evidence underfollowed candidate: its relationship to AI depends on whether high-bandwidth data-center architectures, optical interconnects, or future CPO deployments create qualification-gated demand for specialized connectivity components. Current evidence supports keeping Huber+Suhner in the research graph as a hypothesis, not yet as a confirmed AI chokepoint.
